title: Files read before the batch deadline are thrown away: every file is marked unread
evidence: widget-src/src/lib/upload-pipeline.ts processBatch throws UploadError 'timeout' at the deadline and returns no partial results; widget-src/src/hooks/useUploadFlow.ts catch calls failUnread for every file and finish([]). On the Pages build the files that did finish were paid for on the person's own key (byok-upload.ts runBatch keeps them in a local array nobody reads). On the website a re-pick joins the live batch (US-12 AC25), so only the Pages build loses paid work. Keeping them changes what the person sees (a partial review beside the timeout), so it may need words. Found with US-12 AC5b
